title: Trace and deliberately choose three values

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: An origin explains how a value became salient; it does not decide whether to endorse it. Admiration, belonging, threat of disapproval, temperament and deliberate reasoning can coexist. Reversing a family rule can remain controlled by that rule.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Rae learned reliability from adults who kept promises and also feared criticism for saying no. Rae enjoys solitary work and calls independence a virtue, but acknowledges this may partly reflect temperament. A friend’s freely offered help showed Rae that accepting assistance need not surrender choice. Rae values privacy after thinking through who should control personal information.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Trace three value histories, separating reported influence from your inference. Give each a current disposition and boundary; choose one response to an optional request requiring an unavailable hour.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: Sam declines every family custom solely to avoid resembling a parent, then calls every choice freely reasoned. What is missing?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: Reliability can be retained as making realistic promises, so a clear decline may express it. Independence can be reinterpreted as agency with chosen help. Privacy can be retained with voluntary sharing. Later fiction: Rae declines the hour and offers a genuinely available 10 minutes; acceptance is unknown. Partial: name origins without present reasons. Incorrect: claim independence must be rejected because it has temperamental roots.
criteria: Current reasons and limits are stated
Action and proposed interpretation are distinguished

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: A present reason for each disposition is missing. Sam may still choose to decline, but reversal alone does not show considered endorsement. A retained custom can also be freely chosen.
